Block
Fixture feature: an axis-aligned box (synthetic description).

SYNTAX
model.component(<ctag>).geom(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Block");
model.component(<ctag>).geom(<tag>).feature(<ftag>).set(property,<value>);

DESCRIPTION
Use model.component(<ctag>).geom(<tag>).create(<ftag>,"Block") to create a block.
TABLE 3-31: VALID PROPERTY/VALUE PAIRS.

PROPERTY                 VALUE                   DEFAULT     DESCRIPTION

axis                     double[]                {0,0,1}     Fixture text for Block.axis, wrapped onto a
                                                             second line and a third line so the parser
                                                             has to join continuations.
axistype                 x|y|z|                  z           Fixture text for Block.axistype with a wrapped
                         cartesian |                         value column.
                         spherical
base                     corner | center         corner      Fixture text for Block.base, also wrapped
                                                             onto a second line.
size                     double[]                {1,1,1}     Edge lengths.
pos                      double[]                {0,0,0}     Fixture text for Block.pos.
rot                      double                  0           Fixture text for Block.rot.
type                     solid | surface         solid       Fixture text for Block.type.

EXAMPLE
The following commands create a block.
